title: Itervox memory file
description: Managed memory carried from one Itervox run to the next: ~/.itervox/memory.json (private, never committed) and .itervox/memory.json (project shared, committed). The daemon rewrites these files (it records lastUsed and useCount), so comments are not preserved.

$schema.description: The schema URL, for editor support.

id.description: Unique across both files (case-insensitive). The dashboard generates m-<hex> ids.

text.description: What the agent is told. At most 2000 bytes; secrets are redacted when the daemon saves it.

scope.description: Written by the daemon for reference: the file that holds the entry decides its scope.

profiles.description: Agent profiles the entry is used for (* and ? globs allowed; a run without a named profile is "default"). Missing or empty: every run.

tags.description: Free-form tags. A tag that names an issue label or a word of the issue ranks the entry higher.

pinned.description: A pinned entry is always included in a run's memory block.

status.description: Only active entries are used. proposed: a lesson waiting for a human to approve it in the Memory page's Lessons tab. archived: kept, not used.

source.description: Provenance: where the entry came from and the evidence for it.

issue.description: The tracker identifier the entry came from.

runIds.description: The runs the entry came from.

links.description: PR, comment or other URLs backing the entry.

lastUsed.description: Maintained by the daemon: when a run last had the entry in its prompt.

useCount.description: Maintained by the daemon: how many runs had the entry in their prompt.

lesson.description: A lesson's review record, written by the daemon when it proposes a lesson: what it applies to, what went wrong and what worked, confidence and how often it was seen.

trigger.description: What made Itervox propose it: a reply to an input-required question, a steering message, or a failed run followed by a successful one.

wentWrong.description: What the agent did, or what failed.

correction.description: The human's words the lesson came from (redacted). Proposals are deduplicated on it.

confidence.description: How sure Itervox is; raised each time the same lesson is seen again.

evidence.description: How many times the lesson was seen.

draftedBy.description: template, or profile:<name> for a lesson drafted by an agent profile.

approvedAt.description: When a human approved it (or it was auto-approved).
